caption: The drawing depicts a sculpture of a cherubic, child-like figure from the waist up, rendered in shades of gray and set against a plain, light background. The figure is shown with both arms raised upwards, elbows bent, and hands open, with the fingers slightly spread apart. The head is tilted slightly forward, with curly, textured hair framing a round face featuring pronounced brows, closed lips, and softly defined cheeks. The upper torso is exposed, and the transition from the lower torso to the base of the sculpture is marked by stylized, symmetrical leaf-like carvings. The overall appearance suggests the use of shading to create volume and depth, emphasizing the contours of the arms, chest, and abdomen. The drawing uses subtle tonal variations to suggest the three-dimensional form and material texture of the sculpture.
title: Ship's Figurehead
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
